Name: Special Orders Tweaks
Author: dayLerFar
Description:
[size=6]Features:[/size]
[size=4]1.customize the day unlock Special Order(default is fall 2, the 58th day)

﻿2.money rewards multiplier

﻿3. refresh orders everyday, also add a button to refresh manually.  [s]since ver1.0.2, you can refresh order immediately by reopening board[/s](works with qi's quest.)

﻿4.tweak for order duration. In game, order duration is not exact 7/14/28days. 7/14/28days order expires at end of ﻿week/month. with this enabled, now you have exact 7/14/28days to do it.

[/size][size=6]Install:[/size]
[size=4]﻿1.install required MOD, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size]
[size=4]2.install this mod

[/size][size=6]Compatability:[/size]
[size=4]1.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/size]
﻿ [size=3]1).RidgesideVillage Special order unlock on sameday with Pelican's, and start to generate orders on nextday 
﻿ ﻿2).money rewards multiplier works(not work with some quest that reward via mail , like "MAJOR HELP NEEDED!!")
﻿ ﻿3).RidgesideVillage Special order now refresh everyday too

[size=6]Thanks:[/size]
﻿xeru1998[size=4]: idea about order duration[/size]
[/size]
